LanguageData.Rimverse_ScenGravshipIntro:
Your gravship is docked at an old orbital relay. It is a good ship for this world, but it cannot cross the dark between stars.

The gravship substructure counts as hull for the Rimverse: build a Rimverse bridge on it, then engines, life support and a warp drive. The grav engine works as a maneuver thruster for your starship.

When your starship is ready, use "Enter the star system" on its bridge.
